# David Grimsley

> Portfolio and public developer resources for David Grimsley, including public APIs, MCP servers, production apps, and Quantum API integration guides.

Use these Markdown links when an AI agent needs low-noise source material. Human pages remain available from the same site navigation.

## Quantum API Docs

- [Quantum API](/public-facing/api/quantum.md): Agent entry point with base URL, auth, error shape, live OpenAPI, and endpoint-directory links.
- [Unreal Plugin](/public-facing/api/quantum/ue-plugin.md): UE 5.8 Blueprint integration guide.
- [TypeScript SDK](/public-facing/api/quantum/typescript-sdk.md): Node.js package guide.
- [Python SDK](/public-facing/api/quantum/python-sdk.md): Sync Python client guide.
- [Godot Addon](/public-facing/api/quantum/godot-addon.md): Godot 4 runtime addon guide.
- [Unity Package](/public-facing/api/quantum/unity-package.md): Unity runtime package guide.
- [Full agent context](/llms-full.txt): Fuller site and Quantum API context.
